name: How long does it take to build a custom barbecue island from design to completion?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a custom barbecue island from design to completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a custom barbecue island varies based on design complexity, material availability, and current project schedules. Generally, the design phase can take 2-4 weeks, involving consultations, revisions, and final approvals. Once designs are finalized, permitting (if required) can add another 2-6 weeks. Construction typically ranges from 4-8 weeks, depending on the island's size, features, and the chosen finishes. A realistic total timeframe from initial consultation to completion is often 10-18 weeks.
acceptedAnswer.description: From design to completion, a custom barbecue island typically takes 10-18 weeks. This includes 2-4 weeks for design, 2-6 weeks for permits, and 4-8 weeks for construction.
